rv.q: Heaux Church is no ordinary theater; it is revelation wrapped in rhinestones.
Goodman, it turns out, is a genuinely magnetic priest, and their enthusiasm and vulnerability make their ennobling message worth hearing yet again.
Goodman transforms confession into celebration, leaving the congregation laughing, thinking, and perhaps a little more open to its own messy, marvelous humanity.

cn.t: Brandon Kyle Goodman's joyful solo show transforms sex education into a liberating gospel of pleasure and self-acceptance, with critics praising its ecstatic energy and mission to redefine shame into pride.

vr.q: Truly cannot recommend this show enough.
the show is a good time and Brandon's magnetic authenticity and humor is what keeps you leaned in from start to finish
